notes.title: Changelog for version 3.6.877
notes.content:
- setting window for offline game is now in a proper position
- better scroll list function
- updated app icons in the friend list profile page
- several other improvements and fixes

What’s new:
- Minor bugs fixed
- Server improvements

notes.title: Update 3.4.578
notes.content:
What's new:

- The setting of online games is polished
- Some stability improvements have been made
- Minor technical updates

Bug fixes:
- the app no longer crashes after a few well-centered taps in the online lobby
- each push notification now opens its own target instead of launching the same game over and over
- junk-scarred veteran achievement now has a pretty colorful image after achieving it, just like the rest
- switching turns should be even smoother now

notes.title: Changes in 3.3.81
notes.content:
- The Corporation Inc. button will no longer crash the app, nothing else stopping you from watching our awesome intro over and over again!
- Quick switch is back and you can once again jump from game to game without mid-steps
- All player nicknames are back to their beautiful colorful selves

notes.title: Bug-fix update
notes.content:
It will now be much easier to check the opponents ship quickly during building.
 The game log now scrolls automatically to the last event (hope you won't miss all the manual scrolling).
 If we can't fix your connection issues, we will at least give you nicer pop-up.
 Cyan diplomats can no longer be cloned to multiple ships.
 The Junk-scarred veteran achievement will from now on, really make you face a 100 meteors instead of just 1.
 The hardcore achievement was deemed too frustrating and you can now win it, even if all others are replaced by AI.
 In the campaign mission with the Alter Ego, the tiles on its ship will no longer be invisible.
 Clicking the Corporation Incorporated logo, will no longer crash your app and will even show you the intro again!

notes.title: Castle TriCon Spring 2021 and Free Weekend on Steam!
notes.content:
Join us this weekend!
Dear Leaders and Truckers! Do you have any plans for the weekend? No? Great! We've got two exciting FREE events for you:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34482889/c7464a5994c8fb3b889e3e7458e03bde7701b68e.png

Castle TriCon 2021 Spring Edition
We miss you! And we miss sharing our games with you. So we came up with a solution - Castle TriCon 2021 Spring Edition - a virtual gaming convention in our unique 3D world where you can run around, explore, play demos of our board games, chat with your friends, or make new ones. Completely FOR FREE!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34482889/e2f6fca418de124ef20f1afaa1e6fdbc03450a44.gif

We are also hosting a few contests, scavenger hunts, and giveaways so you can win some fantastic prizes as well (you guessed it, it’s mostly board games...but we know you love board games).

You just need to get your free ticket and download our virtual world, and you are all set! We can't wait to see you there!

Free Weekend for CGE Digital Games
On top of that, we are also hosting a Free Weekend event here on Steam.

What is it, you ask? From February 25th, 10AM PT until March 1st, 10AM PT, you can install and play our digital games Through the Ages and Galaxy Trucker for free as well!

So if you wanted to buy them but were not sure if you would like them -- or tried to persuade your friends to try -- then now is a perfect time. You can challenge yourself and play against our AI opponents, play local games with your family and friends, or start your career as a Galaxy Trucker in our solo campaign mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34482889/6b1f6a69fd61fa28ce2d703a0ea5b298302db0b1.png

And if you like the games, you can buy them at a discounted price this weekend! Oh, and be sure to visit our TriCon friends from Horrible Guild, they are running a free weekend and some juicy sales as well.

Yours,
CGE Team

notes.title: Galaxy Trucker Finally Lands on Steam!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34482889/1422392f5984236cbabf535be1c24f1986950b83.gif

Exciting news – our shuttles have successfully landed on Steam! Repeat, the shuttles have landed, and our brave space explorers have started colonizing computers all over this new strange land. To support these colonization efforts, we’ve set up a 38% discount that will last until 14 March.

Join in, and discover a new wider Galaxy! Enjoy Galaxy Trucker on a bigger screen of your Mac or Windows :)

Galaxy Trucker: Extended Edition already includes the Alien Technologies expansion and supports cross-platform multiplayer.
